description: This file declares structures and functions related to traversing and managing reflog entries in a version control system, likely Git. It provides function prototypes for initializing, releasing, and iterating over reflog data, as well as for displaying and retrieving reflog messages and identifiers.

methods.name: init_reflog_walk
methods.description: Initializes a reflog walk information structure.

methods.name: reflog_walk_info_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with reflog walk info.

methods.name: add_reflog_for_walk
methods.description: Adds a reflog entry for walking, associating a commit with a name.

methods.name: show_reflog_message
methods.description: Displays the reflog message with options for filtering by date.

methods.name: get_reflog_message
methods.description: Retrieves the reflog message into a buffer.

methods.name: get_reflog_ident
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier of the reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_timestamp
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of the reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_selector
methods.description: Generates a reflog selection string based on date mode and other options.

methods.name: reflog_walk_empty
methods.description: Checks if the reflog walk is empty.

methods.name: next_reflog_entry
methods.description: Advances to the next reflog entry.
